description: Ajantha Mendis at the point of delivery. He bowls with the carrom ball style, flicking between his middle finger and thumb to release it, giving him the ability to spin the ball in either direction without the batsman noticing a difference in his action. Picture taken during day one of the County Championship match between Somerset and Warwickshire at the County Ground, Taunton.
caption: Archive Ajantha Mendis delivery photograph. This illustrates a different spin method for comparison, not Kuldeep Yadav or his wrist-spin action.
